subject: Highcharts export button missing when deploy to shiny-server 0.4

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Highcharts export button missing when deploy to shiny-server 0.4
parts:
Hi all,
  I am using the new released shiny-server . It works nice except the highcharts exporting button missed. When run it locally, or deployed it to shiny-server 0.3 on a virtual machine it works well.  Here is a test app:

    http://spark.rstudio.com/withr/highcharts_button/


and the source code:

## server.R
require(rCharts)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$myChart <- renderChart({
    chart <- Highcharts$new() 
    chart$legend(align = "right", verticalAlign = "middle", layout = "vertical")
    chart$exporting(sourceWidth = 1000, sourceHeight = 400)
    chart$addParams(dom = "myChart") 
    chart$tooltip(crosshairs = TRUE)
    dat <- data.frame(id = 1:nrow(airquality), airquality[, 1:4])
    chart$xAxis(tickLength = 0,categories = as.character(dat$id))
    chart$series(name = input$x,data = dat[, input$x])
    chart 
  })
})


## ui.R
require(rCharts)
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
    selectInput(inputId = "x", label = "Choose X",
                choices = c("Ozone",  "Solar.R", "Wind", "Temp")
  ),
    chartOutput("myChart", lib = "highcharts")
))

Anybody can help to figure out the problem?

Best!

Huidong

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
